title: Baselines and Score Centering in Policy Gradient Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a widely used approach to post-training large language models. In a typical implementation, learning is off-policy: The policy generating the responses differs from the policy being trained because of training-inference mismatch or policy staleness in asynchronous training. This discrepancy is commonly addressed by importance sampling, whose ratio is usually regularized in practice through truncation, masking, or clipping. Under regularized importance sampling, the importance-weighted policy gradient is no longer invariant to constant shifts in the reward. This invariance is recovered by using the covariance between the reward and the importance-weighted score as the estimand, which coincides with the policy gradient when the ratio is not regularized. translated_title: 策略梯度估计中的基线与得分中心化
translated_abstract: 强化学习已成为对大型语言模型进行后训练的一种广泛使用的方法。在典型实现中，学习是离策略的：由于训练与推理之间的不匹配，或异步训练中的策略滞后，生成响应的策略与正在被训练的策略并不相同。这种差异通常通过重要性采样来解决，其比率在实践中通常通过截断、掩码或裁剪等方式进行正则化。在正则化重要性采样下，重要性加权的策略梯度不再对奖励的常数平移保持不变。通过采用奖励与重要性加权得分之间的协方差作为估计对象，可以恢复这种不变性；当比率未被正则化时，该估计对象与策略梯度相一致。本文针对序列级和词元级两种重要性采样发展了这一协方差视角。协方差视角揭示了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出在正则化重要性采样的离策略强化学习中，应以奖励与重要性加权得分之间的协方差作为估计对象，从而恢复策略梯度对奖励常数平移的不变性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using the covariance between the reward and the importance-weighted score as the estimand under regularized importance sampling, restoring the invariance of policy gradient estimation to constant reward shifts in off-policy RL training.
